outcome: Anthropometric and metabolic outcomes at peripubertal age
cohort: The study participants were 78 very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm infants born in a single center between 2005 and 2009.
finding: The study confirmed that Small for Gestational Age (SGA) infants at birth developed Extra-uterine Growth Restriction (EUGR) at discharge, which was associated with metabolic developments, including lower HDL cholesterol and higher fasting blood glucose, noted at peripubertal age.
